tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The outer black of the key visual: poster and slide bleeds, the far end of `gradient-space`, the base under `Starfield`. Every ink and glow reads on it.

tokens.name: deep-space
tokens.usage: Page ground for every screen, slide, social tile and document, and the fill of panel tab labels. All inks, glows, `pink`, `blue` and `cyan` read on it as text.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Fill of `Panel` and any surface raised off `deep-space`. The neon edge, not the fill, is what sets a panel apart, so keep the step this small.

tokens.name: nebula
tokens.usage: Purple haze in backgrounds (`gradient-space`, `Starfield`). Text on it: `ink`, `ink-soft`, `ink-muted` and the glows only; no `violet` or `blue` marks here.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between service tiles and rows inside panels. Decorative only (2.1:1 on `deep-space`): never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that alone mark a control: input, select and checkbox borders (3.4:1 on `deep-space` and `panel`). Decorative dividers stay `line`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Names, headlines, panel tab labels and button labels on `deep-space`, `panel`, `void` and `nebula` (18:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and service labels on `deep-space` and `panel` (15:1 or better); softer than `ink` for anything longer than a line.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines ("INTELLIGENT BUSINESSES", "EST. 2003"), captions and metadata on `deep-space` and `panel` (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Neon Pink, the lead pole (the "3" of the wordmark, strategy, the human side): panel edges, icon primaries, the first stop of `gradient-neon`. Text on `deep-space` and `panel` (6.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Neon Violet, only ever between pink and blue: gradient midpoints, the halo ring, nebula light. Strokes and marks on `deep-space` and `panel` (3.0:1 or better); never text.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Electric Blue: the Core Work panel edge, smoke and the right side of the halo; the last stop of `gradient-neon`. Text on `deep-space` and `panel` only (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Neon Cyan, the tech pole (the "S" of the wordmark): icon details, circuit traces, focus. Text on every ground (11.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: pink-glow
tokens.usage: Pink as light-emitting type: highlighted words ("STRATEGIC") and the first stop of `gradient-glow`, on `deep-space`, `panel` and `nebula` (8.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: violet-glow
tokens.usage: Middle stop of `gradient-glow` and violet highlighted words, on `deep-space`, `panel` and `nebula` (8.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Cyan as light-emitting type: highlighted words ("GROWTH ADVISOR") and the last stop of `gradient-glow`, on `deep-space`, `panel` and `nebula` (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on a glow fill: the `Button` glow variant and anything filled with `gradient-glow` (8.9:1 or better on `pink-glow`, `violet-glow` and `cyan-glow`).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text, always underlined, on `deep-space` and `panel`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus colour, drawn by the `focus-ring` shadow; 12:1 or better on `deep-space` and `panel`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed states and destructive actions: text and icons on `deep-space` and `panel` (5.7:1 or better), tints behind danger text at 20% at most, fills under an `on-danger` label. Always with a word or icon: it sits close to `pink` in lightness.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on a `danger` fill (5.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and completed states: text and icons on `deep-space` and `panel` (14:1 or better), tints behind them, fills under an `on-success` label. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on a `success` fill (15:1).

families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Montserrat set in capitals with air between the letters. The brand's move is contrast: Light (300) against ExtraBold (800), and tracking that widens as the text gets smaller.

styles.name: name-light
styles.usage: First line of a name lockup, or the quiet half of a two-line statement. Uppercase, `ink`; always paired with `name-bold` beneath it.

styles.name: name-bold
styles.usage: Second line of a name lockup, or the one loud word of a slide. Uppercase, `ink`; two words at most.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: FUELING GROWTH AT THE INTERSECTION OF
styles.usage: The brand lines at the top and foot of a composition, filled with `gradient-glow` through `GradientText`. Uppercase, one line, nothing else on it.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Descriptor lines under a name or the wordmark. Uppercase `ink`; the two or three words that matter go to 800 in `pink-glow` or `cyan-glow` through `Highlight`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Panel tab labels and section kickers. Uppercase, `ink`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase markers set between neon rules (`Eyebrow`). `ink-muted`.

styles.name: service
styles.usage: Service tile labels under an icon and award names: uppercase, two lines at most, `ink-soft`.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Sentence case for anything longer than a line.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Growth at the intersection of strategy and tech
styles.usage: Section headings in documents, web pages and dense slides. Sentence case, `ink`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Strategic development and growth advice for intelligent businesses, since 2003.
styles.usage: Running text in `ink-soft` on `deep-space` or `panel`, kept to the `measure` width.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: YE Awards 2019 · Young Entrepreneur of the Year
styles.usage: Metadata, figure notes, award details and footers in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and data in material about AI systems; `cyan-glow` or `ink-soft` on `panel`.

spacing.note: 4px base. Panels breathe: 24px inside, 12px between side-by-side panels, 16px between tiles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tab label top and bottom padding; the gap between an award mark and its detail line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a button icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in a service tile; gap between side-by-side panels; rule-to-text gap in an `Eyebrow`.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Service tile padding; inset of the vertical hairlines from a tile's top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding and button side padding; tab label side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a composition: name lockup to wordmark to descriptor; panel top padding under a tab.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section spacing on web pages; slide margins at 1280px wide.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer margin of posters, hero slides and social tiles.

radius.note: Rounded, never soft: panels at 18px, tabs and buttons at 10px, full circles only for the halo, nodes and portraits.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panel tab labels and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels (AWARDS, CORE WORK) and image frames; measured from the key visual.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The halo ring, circuit nodes and round portraits.

shadow.note: Depth comes from light, not from shadow: every elevation is a glow in a brand hue.

tokens.name: glow-pink
tokens.usage: Bloom around pink-led elements: the Awards panel, the glow button.

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Bloom around blue-led elements: the Core Work panel.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Hover and active light on interactive elements.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px `deep-space` gap, then 2px of `focus` (box-shadow, so it follows the radius). The two hexes are `deep-space` and `cyan`; change them together.

gradient.note: Light always travels pink to cyan, left to right, the order of the wordmark.

tokens.name: gradient-glow
tokens.usage: Type filled with light: the brand taglines (`GradientText`) and the glow button fill. Stops are `pink-glow`, `violet-glow`, `cyan-glow`.

tokens.name: gradient-neon
tokens.usage: Edges, rules and strokes that carry the brand's light: panel borders, the outline button, horizon lines. Stops are `pink`, `violet`, `blue`.

tokens.name: gradient-space
tokens.usage: Flat full-bleed background for posters, hero slides and social tiles when `Starfield` can't run: `nebula` haze rising from the lower left into `void`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Button height; also the minimum hit area for anything clickable.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Service icons in tiles and grids.

tokens.name: icon-inline
tokens.usage: Icons beside text or inside buttons, drawn without glow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for `body` text.
